steamId.description: The Steam ID of the Steam account for which the App IDs should be fetched. The Steam ID is a 17-digit number that uniquely identifies a Steam account. It is located under your account name on the top left of https://store.steampowered.com/account/. The Steam ID can also be found in the URL when viewing a profile, the URL will look similar to https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/00000000000000000/. Alternatively, use sites such as https://steamid.io to get the SteamID64 value for a given account name.

steamAPIKey.description: Your Steam Web API key. You can get one for free here: https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Provide this via the STEAM_API_KEY environment variable - storing it here is no longer allowed and the tool will refuse to run if it is set.

outputProperties.description: Which of the properties provided by the Steam API should be included in the resulting JSON object. Properties that are not available for an app will be omitted in the output.

appID.description: The App ID of the game.

logo.description: The URL to the game's logo.

storeLink.description: The URL to the game's store page.

statsLink.description: The URL to this users stats page for this game.

globalStatsLink.description: The URL to the global stats page for this game.
